Name: JOJA TAKEOVER

Description:
JOJA IS TAKING OVER!!

- Moved JojaBean Seeds and JojaBrew Deluxe to be purchased at second counter in JojaMart.

COMING SOON:
- possibly more crops and machines
- joja themed buildings (We are employing robin!)
Sponsored by Joja Corporation. Join Us. Thrive.
